r0_warmup_arithmetic.note: Generic source-support arithmetic only; corporate-action touched/ineligible bars or other load-bearing missingness may delay eligibility. This is not an outcome-selected threshold.

rule.exclude_floor_suspect: Exclude an entire ticker key from R0 when an overlapping membership interval begins exactly on a known index reconstruction floor and the first observed vendor date is later than max(R2 start, interval start). Do not substitute first price for membership/listing start.
rule.exclude_vendor_unresolved: BPFH and UAA/UA yield no admitted R0 spell.
rule.identity_claim: Vendor-ticker observational continuity only. No uninterrupted issuer/security identity claim. Current aliases are never backdated.
rule.include: PIT S&P1500 member-date observations only when the ticker key is not reconstruction-floor suspect, resolves uniquely to the admitted Daily vendor object, and belongs to a membership-bounded source-contiguous vendor-ticker spell.
rule.share_class_normalization: Only previously-qualified unique dot-to-dash vendor mappings are allowed.
rule.spell_boundary: Missing expected source session or genuine union-S&P1500 non-membership hiatus terminates a spell; never bridge after outcomes.
